note: Logical boundaries and harness IDs are proposed. This map is not an approved full Source Pack, software architecture, deployment design or authorization for product implementation.

modules.name: Workspace & Product Portfolio
modules.purpose: Workspaces, products, briefs, versions, lifecycle states and the single create-product entry point.

modules.name: Market & Demand Intelligence
modules.purpose: Evidence-led niche and audience research, demand signals, source freshness, confidence and competitor observations.

modules.name: Audience, Positioning & Offer Strategy
modules.purpose: Audience outcomes, positioning, offer structure, pricing hypotheses, and optional main-offer, order-bump and upsell ladder.

modules.name: Research, Evidence & Rights Ledger
modules.purpose: Source provenance, citations, claim-to-source links, licensing, permissions, freshness and asset origins.

modules.name: Editorial Studio
modules.purpose: Structured outline and manuscript drafting, chapter editing, voice consistency, versions and review notes.

modules.name: Content Quality & Trust
modules.purpose: Fact, consistency, originality, completeness, readability and policy checks; route risky claims to qualified human review.

modules.name: Brand & Visual Studio
modules.purpose: Art direction, covers, purposeful illustrations, diagrams, charts, captions, alt text and provenance-aware asset creation.

modules.name: E-book Composition & Export
modules.purpose: Compile structured content into polished digital and print-ready layouts; candidate outputs include accessible PDF and reflowable EPUB with rendered-page preflight.

modules.name: Digital Asset Vault & Versioning
modules.purpose: Versioned manuscripts, exports, images and creatives with checksums, licenses, prompts, lineage and rollback.

modules.name: Sales Page & Conversion Studio
modules.purpose: Truthful mobile-first offer pages, copy and creative variants, accessibility/performance checks and controlled experiments.

modules.name: Commerce, Checkout & Fulfilment
modules.purpose: Capability-gated commerce adapters for product/checkout actions, purchase/refund events, entitlement and delivery handoff.

modules.name: Customer Lifecycle & CRM
modules.purpose: Consent-aware onboarding, support, feedback, refund insight and relevant next-product journeys.

modules.name: Instagram Profile & Organic Studio
modules.purpose: Profile strategy, content calendar, captions, carousels/reels/story assets and only officially supported publishing operations.

modules.name: Paid Campaign Studio
modules.purpose: Meta campaign planning, audience/creative variants, preview, launch, measurement and pause through explicit account capabilities and spend policy.

modules.name: Autonomy Policy & Spend Guard
modules.purpose: Per-account and per-campaign operating modes, hard budget caps, approval rules, kill switch, idempotency, spend ledger and fail-closed stop behavior.

modules.name: Attribution, Economics & Growth Experiments
modules.purpose: Join consented funnel, sales, ad cost, fees and refund signals; report uncertainty and optimize for net contribution rather than clicks alone.

modules.name: Durable Workflow Orchestrator
modules.purpose: Resumable end-to-end workflows with checkpoints, retries, idempotency, approvals, bounded jobs and clear recovery states.

modules.name: Integration & AI Provider Control Plane
modules.purpose: Capability registry, API/version and permission checks, credential references, quotas, model routing, cost tracking and safe fallbacks.

modules.name: Identity, Privacy, Security & Audit
modules.purpose: Identity, workspace boundaries, least privilege, consent, retention/deletion, secret redaction, revocation and immutable action evidence.

modules.name: Harness, Simulation & Evaluation Lab
modules.purpose: Harness registry, deterministic fixtures, connector fakes, workflow simulations, e-book quality evaluations and bounded evidence packets.

shared_harnesses.purpose: Verify only documented Kiwify capabilities through deterministic contract fixtures; product-write capability stays assisted until confirmed.
Verify professional-account publishing/read capabilities, permission errors and rate/partial-failure handling using fixtures or an authorized sandbox.
Verify Meta campaign/ad-set budget and insight adapter contracts, permissions, pause and reconciliation using fixtures or an authorized sandbox.
Check generated PDF/EPUB structure and rendered-page quality for overflow, missing assets/fonts, broken links, navigation, legibility and accessibility metadata.
Simulate event joins, refunds, fees, attribution uncertainty and contribution-margin decisions with seeded synthetic datasets.
Prove daily/total cap boundaries, stale-spend data fail-closed behavior, kill switch, idempotency and reconciliation with a fake provider.
Prove pause/resume, duplicate delivery, retries, checkpoints and recovery across a synthetic product workflow.
Check source/citation completeness, asset license metadata and traceability from claim to rendered product and sales copy.

cross_cutting_shell.name: Operator Control Center
cross_cutting_shell.purpose: Single place to start a product run, review approvals, inspect failures, preview assets, set policy and read economics; contains no duplicated domain rules.

harness_status_legend.planned: Registered design only; not runnable or evidence of implementation.
harness_status_legend.implemented: Command exists and its bounded check has actually run.
